steps.title: First and last name
steps.body: Enter them as in your passport: identity verification later checks against these details.

steps.title: Email
steps.body: You will receive a confirmation link and all account notifications here.

steps.title: Phone
steps.body: With the country code, for example +357 25 000 000. Support uses it to reach you.

steps.title: Country
steps.body: The country you live in. It determines the available deposit methods.

steps.title: Password
steps.body: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse a password from other sites.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: After you submit, you go straight to your account. There, confirm your email, verify your identity and turn on two-factor protection.

steps.title: Demo account
steps.body: Practice money: try the terminal without risk. You can reset the account at any time.

steps.title: Real account
steps.body: Your real money. Trading is available after a deposit.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.body: Fund your real account here.

steps.title: Withdrawal
steps.body: Withdraw money from here. A withdrawal may require identity verification.

steps.title: Next steps
steps.body: What to do next: verify your identity, make a deposit, place your first trade.

steps.title: Profile and documents
steps.body: Your profile holds email confirmation, identity verification (a document and a camera selfie) and your documents.

steps.title: Security
steps.body: On the Security tab of your profile you can turn on two-factor protection: signing in will require a code from an app. We recommend it.

steps.title: Trading
steps.body: Open the terminal from here, on the demo or the real account.

steps.title: Repeat the tour
steps.body: Press «?» to go through this tour again.

steps.title: Instruments
steps.body: Instruments with prices. Click a row to open its chart.

steps.title: Categories
steps.body: Tabs split instruments into crypto, forex, metals, stocks and more. Search looks through all of them.

steps.title: Chart
steps.body: The price chart of the selected instrument.

steps.title: Timeframe
steps.body: How much time one candle covers: from a minute to a week.

steps.title: New trade
steps.body: The new trade panel: at market or with a limit order.

steps.title: Volume
steps.body: The trade size. The larger it is, the larger both the profit and the loss.

steps.title: Stop loss and take profit
steps.body: Prices at which the trade closes by itself: limiting the loss or locking in the profit. Always set them.

steps.title: Buy or sell
steps.body: Buy to gain when the price rises, sell to gain when it falls.

steps.title: Open positions
steps.body: Your trades, current profit or loss, orders and history.

steps.title: Close a trade
steps.body: This button closes the trade at the current price.

steps.title: Repeat the tour
steps.body: Press «?» to go through this tour again.
